newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope jokes as takes delivery of new limousine.
newsitem.headline: Pope jokes as takes delivery of new limousine.

text.p: Pope John Paul took delivery of a sleek black convertible limousine on Wednesday and joked to reporters that it was about time he had a new car.
The latest Papal vehicle, a Mercedes S500 fitted with two telephones and white leather upholstery, has a top speed of more than 200 km per hour (125 miles per hour).
"Finally, a new car!" the Roman Catholic Pontiff joked at an official ceremony at the Vatican as Jochen Prange, chairman of Mercedes-Benz Italia, handed over the new customised car.
Among personal touches for the globetrotting Polish Pope were a single rear seat and an image of the Madonna.
The normal version of the car costs more than 150 million lire ($88,000).
The new car, which took a year to fit out, joins a fleet of four other Mercedes -- two "Popemobiles" and two limousines.
Mercedes-Benz has been supplying the Vatican with vehicles since 1930. "Popes have now become good customers," Prange said.
